sandbachFocus: Sandbach United continued their excellent form with two dominant performances. They crushed Telford Town 6-0 away on Saturday 7 November in the league, maintaining their position at the top of the table with a commanding display. Four days later in the Edward Case Cup, they produced an even more emphatic result, demolishing New Mills 7-1 at Church Lane on 14 November, with Kyle Foley scoring a hat-trick and debutant Alfie Carmichael making an immediate impact. The Bach's recent form remains exceptional—they sit 1st with 34 points and have secured wins in their last two outings.
divisionWide: Wolverhampton Casuals maintained their pursuit of Sandbach with an impressive 2-1 midweek win over New Mills and a commanding 3-0 victory over Stafford Town in the Edward Case Cup, keeping them level on points with Sandbach. Eccleshall's fine run came to an end with a narrow 3-2 home defeat to Bilston Town in a dramatic match that saw late goals decide the outcome. AFC Bridgnorth advanced in the cup with a 2-1 extra-time win over Alsager Town. There was better fortune for Telford Town, who bounced back from their heavy Sandbach loss with a 2-0 victory over Cheadle Heath Nomads. In a lively cup tie, Allscott Heath edged a local derby with Dawley Town 3-1 after Dawley had a player sent off late on, while Barnton cruised past Shawbury United 2-0 away in the Edward Case Cup. Market Drayton Town secured their first win under new manager Liam Kelly with a 1-0 victory over Foley Meir, while Brereton Social led their match against Crewe 2-0 at half-time. New Mills and Stafford Town both suffered cup exits this week.
